balls.text: Back of a length on middle and leg, he backs away and swats it to mid-off. KKR finish on 204 for 9

It is a hat-trick but for KKR! Hold on, Starc reckons there's an outside edge and DC review. It is full and just outside off, Rana swings hard at it but seems to have missed it. Russell wants to take the bye and sprints to the other end. Porel meanwhile takes aim, shoots and hits the stumps at his end, Russell has to keep running back to the dugout

THE FLYING CHAMEERA HAS PULLED OFF A SCREAMERRRRRRR! The catch of IPL 2025? Perhaps! Full and on the pad, Roy flicks it nonchalantly over square leg. Looks to be destined to go for a maximum but deep backward square leg charges to his left and flings himself towards the ball and hangs on

Pinned in front, given out lbw! Starc strikes but now Powell wants to review. He was almost starting to walk off. Full and straight on middle and leg from around the stumps, he was deep in th ecrease and misses the tuck, clearly beaten for pace. Three reds and Powell has to continue his trudge back

Angles it down leg from around the stumps, 144.5kph, he misses. Porel has to leap to his left but he cannot prevent the bye. Starc thinks it brushed Russell's pad and has a chat with du Plessis. DC review again, and the ball indeed flicked his pad
Bangs it short, he ducks, and called wide. DC want to have another look. They lose a review as it is well above Russell's head

Russell muscle on show! He stays deep in the crease, prepared for the yorker. And Starc jussst misses the mark and bowls a low full toss that he gets under and deposits it wayyyyy over the sight-screen
Superbly done from Chameera, a 141.9-kph yorker outside off, Russell can only squeeze it wide of cover. Three wides, two fours and the rest of it was fantastic
Another dot as Chameera gets the full and wide ball right, 142.6kph, drilled straight to cover
Goes for the same line again, Chameera, 131.6kph, and Russell leaves it be this time

And now the outside edge is Russell's friend. Full and very wide outside off, would have been wide had he let it be. But Dre Russ throws his hands at that and gets the toe end very fine, just wide of short third
Oh dear, dear. Nair, what have you done? Chameera got this absolutely spot-on - the full and wide ball that Russell can only slap to deep cover. But the spin undoes Nair
Low full toss just outside off, heaved off the inner half to long-on, 133.2kph
Full and wide again, Powell tries to reach out but misses. And wide called again
Spears it full and wide, it goes outside the tramline. He will have to re-bowl that
Very full and wide outside off, squeezed to deep point
Smartly done. Powell moves across the stumps and paddles the googly fine. Looked like he anticipated the wrong'un and executed it well, not letting the previous ball affect him
Huge appeal for lbw, not given. And Nigam shakes his head about the review. The googly beats Powell on the inside and hits him high on the back leg

Googly on off and middle, wristed to the on side. Axar sprints from midwicket, dives and half-stops it but wrings his left hand in pain. Must have slammed the surface hard. And Axar is off the field straightaway

Rinkooooooo..... goneee!!! Thought he had connected it well. This is what Rinku had done all the hard work for - to cash in at the death. He misses out and admonishes himself as he walks back. Gets down to play the slog but hits it straight to Starc at the edge of the long-on boundary
Quicker legbreak on middle and leg, he taps it to the on side and sprints. Kuldeep charging to the all from midwicket didn't deter Dre Russ
Half-tracker angling away, he pulls it down the ground. Starc has to cover a lot of ground to his right at long-on and keeps it down to just one
Yorker again, outside the sixth stump, Dre Russ looks to squeeze it out but misses. Seven runs and a wicket to start the death overs phase for DC
Bowls it very full and wide outside off, Russell watches it through. Called wide, and DC don't contest it

All height, no distance. Raghuvanshi had to go for it and he goes irrespective, given KKR's batting might in the dugout. Charges down the track early, giving himself the room. Chameera bowls the legcutter outside off. He reaches out and slices it straight to sweeper cover. End of a fine innings, perhaps at the right time for KKR
Another wide yorker outside off, he squeezes it to short fine leg off the inside edge
Perfect yorker on middle and leg, squeezed through midwicket

The good ol'd French cut comes to Raghuvanshi's aid. A similar delivery from Chameera - a very wide yorker. He reaches out to it away from his body, gets a thick inside edge well wide of the keeper and short fine leg
Starts wide of the crease and spears a very wide yorker, 138.6kph, Raghuvanshi leaves it thinking it to be a wide but it lands inside the tramline
Flatter length ball on leg, nudged through midwicket for a double
Floated full down leg, he misses the sweep. Called wide this time
Lands it on a length on off and middle, 97.3kph, goes back to heave it away to long-on
Fuller and wider outside off, 99.2kph, slapped to the left of backward point
Fuller outside off, eased to sweeper cover
Quicker and flatter down leg, he goes for the sweep but gloves it towards short fine leg
Darts a short-of-length ball outside off, skewed off the outer half to long-off

Fantastic effort from Axar but will go down as a drop. He leaps high, uses every bit of his height to get both hands to it but fails to hang on. Raghuvanshi looks to go inside out and it almost cost him. Wouldn't have mattered because Nigam has overstepped
More use of the feet from Rinku. Charges down to get to the pitch of the ball and hits it straight over the non-striker this time, 17 runs off the first over after the timeout
Nimble feet from Rinku and he gets a maximum. Flighted wide outside off, full in length, Rinku gives the charge, reaches it and deposits it right over the bowler
Cuts the awayspinning length ball to backward point
Spinning away from a length outside off, sliced through point for a brace
Pulled away in fine fashion. Short again from Kuldeep, Rinku has enough time to hammer it through midwicket
Spinning in on a length on leg, clipped through square leg
Lands it on a length on middle, 90.5kph, looked like the arm ball, he clips it through midwicket. End of a fine spell from Axar
Length ball slanting away, flat-batted down to long-on
Fires it down leg, full as well, he misses the tuck. Not called wide though. Half an appeal but not much thought later. Turns out there was a feather of an edge!
Throws it well wide outside off, easy leave
Flatter length ball outside off, punched down to long-off off the back foot
Full on off, driven back to Axar
Rinku reverses but gets just one. The length ball lands outside leg, and he manages to hit it straight to deep backward point
Anticipates the charge and throws it wider, he reaches out and drives the wrong'un straight to cover. Good over from Kuldeep this
Fuller on leg, defended back down the surface

Just short of short fine leg. Du Plessis dives forward after getting to his right and yet it does not carry. This was down leg and Raghuvanshi went for the sweep, top-edging it almost straight to the man in the ring
Fuller on middle, clipped through midwicket
Floated up on middle, he comes down the track and chips it towards extra cover
Fuller around off, pushed to the off side
Powers the cut away, so much so that backward point dives and gets a hand but still it races away. Shorter and quicker outside off, Raghuvanshi goes deep in his crease and slashes it
Slower through the air outside off, on a length, slapped to deep cover
Fuller on middle, nudged through midwicket
Fuller on middle, flicked down to long-on
Flatter and on a length on middle and leg, clipped through midwicket for a brace
Flatter on off, clipped through midwicket
Flatter and on a length on off, punched off the back foot to cover. The one dot ball in the Kuldeep over
Googly, fuller around off, he comes forward with bat and pad close, taps it well in front of point
Spins away from a fullish length, patted through cover
Walloped! Half-tracker on middle and leg, looks like the wrong'un. Enough time for Rinku to go back and pull it over square leg
Quicker one on middle and leg, tucked away forward of square on the on side
Fuller ball on off, 86.5kph, he leans forward, flicks it through midwicket and hares back for two
Shortish on top of middle, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Length outside off, punched to the bowler's right
Full on leg, flicked towards midwicket. Axar runs across and stops it
Full on off, worked to long-on

Iyer skies it straight up and bags a single-figure score. The 90ks fullish ball was angling away well outside off, Iyer had a big swipe across the line. He was reaching out, may have wanted to hit it across too, got it right off the bottom. Vipraj takes a few strides from cover to take a simple catch
On the back foot early. Iyer flicks it from leg stump through square leg
Flicks the fullish ball at the stumps through midwicket
Inside out over extra this time. Timing is as terrific as the placement. Raghuvanshi lifted that length ball on the rise, he had a bit of width to work with. Hit it with the spin too

Looped and that's a step-hit over the bowler. Stock ball again, Vipraj looks for spin but bowls a touch too full, the forward stride was on point, got the batter close to the pitch. The bat swing was controlled too
Same pace, length ball on off. It spun in, so might have been a googly, cramped Raghuvanshi who looked to get on the back foot. Adjusted the shot late, bunted it into the pitch
Full on middle and off, 97ks legbreak, driven to cover
Fullish outside off, driven to cover point
Dances down and flicks the quickish length ball to the bowler
Iyer backs away and drives off the back foot through cover. Not much width there, was length too, but the shot made the ball look short and wide
Dances down and flicks the full ball through midwicket
Fullish, touch slow, outside off; driven to long-off

Rahane does a Ponting, walks away before being given LBW.  Was a length ball from around the wicket that landed around fourth and skidded straight. Rahane's feet were jammed and he was beaten on the flick both by angle and pace. Hawk-Eye shows that was smashing leg. Couple of quick wickets for DC after KKR's flier
Fullish on the pads, beaten on the flick

Slip's out after one ball and that's where the edge goes... Vipraj getting turn and bounce is a positive for DC though. Fuller side of length around off, went through fourth; Raghuvanshi was tentative on the open-faced defensive push. He actually went searching, bat faced point by the time he was done - but got away with it
Loopy legbreak outside off, overpitched, driven through cover

Pinned lbw, that looked dead. Narine slogged across the line but the 97ks legbreak landed right in front of middle and straightened a touch, skidded through to beat bat and hit him on the back pad as it slanted towards the ground.
Touch fuller on leg, clipped through midwicket
Expertly placed back-foot flick. Fielder charges from deep midwicket but has no chance. Was a shortish ball on leg that was chipped
Wide on a length, very slow, cut to sweeper cover
Overpitched on off, 139ks, flicked to midwicket.
Makes room, gets followed by the full ball. He manages to squeeze a drive to cover along the ground
Starc saves three. Gets low to the left and gets both hands on the racing ball at point. Low fully outside off, Rahane timed the square drive nicely
Goes past the pull. Appeal for caught behind brings out the wide call. Seemed like a back-of-length ball, angle in was sharp
Makes room, gets yorked. It was at the stumps, looks to jam it through point. Gets it off the toe to short fine leg
This is more of a slice but just as powerful and well timed. Off a length, in the channel, top of the bounce too. Rahane stands upright and goes through with the drive
Cut due to the line more than length. That was fuller side of length, fifth-stump line and Rahane got the horizontal bat out in flow
146ks. Another yorker attempt. Ends up as a full ball on middle and leg, glanced to deep fine leg
Overcompensation from Starc. Goes for the yorker, bowls a low full toss on the pads, gets flicked through midwicket
Swept on the rise! Rahane gets deep in the crease, crouches, had the knee just above the ground while picking the length ball off the stumps. It sails over square leg
Field was set for the bumper, the ball was shortish but more back of length. 140ks, lands just outside leg and hits the thigh pad after beating the pull. Pops leg side
Clips the length ball on leg to square leg for a quick single. 145ks
Ouch, that'll sting. Narine was backing away again and got followed by a length ball. He lifted the front leg and tried to pull it behind square. It hit the thigh and popped to the side
Fullish ball just outside off, 141ks, punched neatly to mid-off
Length on top of leg, 140ks, pulled hard again. This time it's not middled. Along the ground, to long-on, it goes
Yorker angling sharply down leg. Narine cleared the front leg before twirling to get it out the way and let the ball go
Pulled over wide mid-on. Heck of a shot given it was a 142ks hard-length ball angling in over middle. Narine cleared the front leg and flat-batted it on top of the bounce
Narine clears the front leg, sees the 128ks short ball sponge high over fifth stump and lets it go. One bouncer for the over, square-leg ump signals
Yorker on middle, jams a drive to cover
Bouncer angling in over fourth, let go

Appeal for caught behind. Starc is convinced. Umpires confer, send it upstairs. Was this a bump ball or a call for fair catch? Third ump says bump ball. The attempted yorker at 140ks landed beside the the batter's front foot. It was angling in towards off, Gurbaz tried to jam it with a straightish bat. There was a small gap between bat and pad, and he did indeed get an edge as the toe of the bat dug into the ground. The ball hovered and went low to Porel's right. He took it cleanly. KKR's highest opening stand for the season so far ends
Uses the pace and hooks the short ball. Looked like Gurbaz got the eyes off the ball, head down too, upon impact but the bat swing was free
Test-length, Test-line, Test dab wide of short third. Three-quarter length on fourth, Gurbaz angled the vertical bat towards cover and played it late
Wide yorker, close to the tramline, Gurbaz has his feet planted and reaches out with his torso to try and jam it square. Misses
Cross seam or scramble? Looks like scramble to me, Knight on air says cross though. Either way, the 134ks ball was shortish and at the stumps, Gurbaz top edged a pull that went over the keeper
Low full toss on leg, clipped through the leg side

French cut off the slower ball takes it perilously close to the stumps, but it goes past the keeper and real fine. Ball was on a fuller side of length around fifth stump, Gurbaz leant across and tried to push it towards cover. Played in front of the body
Leg-stump yorker attempted, it lands on a full length. Narine makes room and thrashes it to long-on
One-handed biff with full extension. The wind-up was big but slow, the downswing was where the bat picked up pace to launch the fullish slower ball over midwicket. Taken from the stumps
Defensive bowling continues. Back of length, trying to follow Narine as he made room. Too far down leg, past the attempted pull it goes
Chipped just over the leaping midwicket fielder. This one did swing in a touch and Narine was backing away again, didn't wind up properly but shovelled the ball up and over anyway
At the ankles again, Narine clears the front leg and clips it through wide mid-on
This time Chameera does try to cramp Narine as he makes room, but the overpitched ball is well down leg. Narine, with the front leg cleared, lets it pass

Narine slides leg side and pumps it over the bowler. 140ks full ball just down leg, no swing. Too full and Narine was able to get underneath and drive through the line. Didn't look like Chameera was looking to follow Narine.
Starc goes back in search of swing and gets square driven through point. The seventh-stump ball didn't swing and was overpitched, was smothered into the ground on one knee by Gurbaz
Bumper beats pull. Starc smiles. That was above middle stump, around shoulder-height; Gurbaz went back in the crease and looked to go square. Beaten for pace
Length around fourth, defended towards point. Fielder swoops in to deny the single
Cut nicely, that's reassuring for the batters. The 141ks ball came on nicely off a length, had width too. Gurbaz timed it well but found point
Confusion in running, both batters a third of the way down before Narine sends Gurbaz back. No danger in the end. Was a shortish ball at the hip that beat the pull and popped towards square leg
A bit of swing in but overpitched, it's on off-stump. Gurbaz didn't take much of a stride, was in front of leg stump - beside the ball's line - and drove with the full face. Races past the bowler
Full toss on leg, whipped to deep midwicked. KKR win by 14 runs and take two crucial points to stay alive

Goes for a fancy shot and is knocked over! Nigam looks to reverse swipe it over third but never manages to get under it. The ball dips under him and makes a mess of the stumps. A turbo-charged cameo comes to an end, in vain
Full outside off, Nigam once again clears his front leg and muscles it through cover but that is not enough for DC.
Very full on middle, 131.3kph, drilled straight back at the bowler
Fooouuuurrrrr! Nigam's hands. Uffff! Full, fast and on off, he clears his front leg, gets his bat down at high speed and with a slightly open face to smack it through cover

And they get a bye! Yorker tailing back in, Chameera misses it completely. But Nigam is clear he wants to get back on strike, and so runs straightaway. Gurbaz throws wildly and misses everything and goes to long-off
Slower length ball outside off, he swings hard and gets a thick bottom edge towards the keeper. No run, very important for KKR. Nigam knows it and throws his head back in dejection

What hand speed that is. And what quick running. Full and outside off, he scythes it through point. Roy charges to the ball and it should have been just one. But he was deciding where to throw and took a moment for that. And that moment was enough for Nigam to come sprinting back for the second. He dives full-stretch just as Gurbaz whips the bails off and that saves Nigam

HUUUUGGGEEEEE! Is there life in this chase yet? Rana repeatedly giving Nigam the width he so desires. Full and wide length ball outside off, pace on as well,. Nigam reaches it, swings hard and sends it sailing over deep point
Slower length ball outside off, he hacks it through mid-on but doesn't run
Edge, flies! Full and outside off, aiming for the yorker, Nigam clears his front leg and goes hard at it. No half-measures and it flies over short third
Length ball outsided off, he swings hard and gets a thick inside edge onto his pad and towards square leg

Powerrrrr and goes the distance! Varun goes pace on, angles it across, lands it in the slot on middle and off. Nigam clears his front leg and sends it sailing over cover. Eight runs and two wickets off Varun's last over
Flatter length ball down leg, Nigam looks to swipe it over short fine leg but only gloves it around the corner
Fuller outside off, driven down to long-on

That is highhhhhhh and not long. Flatter length ball slanting away from him, Starc looks to slog it across the line but skies it high. Gurbaz comes forward a few steps, calls clearly and takes it. Two-in-two for Varun

Ashutosh falls and with that DC's hopes. Varun is bowling from around the wicket with three me deep on the leg side. And so when Ashutosh sees the length ball around middle, he looks to explore the off side. Goes for the reverse hit over third but hits it straight to Narine at backward point. Either side of that fielder, it would have been runs
Goes length from around the wicket, he slaps it to long-off
Yorker just outside off, he misses squeezing it out. Rana smiles, Ashutosh smiles back and they share a friendly punch, 11 off the over, DC need more

Humongous! The slower one goes wrong again for Rana. He lands it in a slot outside off, Ashutosh manages to get underneath it after clearing the front foot. Makes superb contact to send it well over long-off
Low full toss on off and middle, 140.5kph, he backs away and slices it to deep backward point's left

Connects this time and gets four! A juicy full toss outside off, 139.1kph, Nigam walks across and scoops it over short fine leg. Rana's idea to go full and straight is right, execution not so this time
Full and outside off, he swings for the aisles and makes contact with thin air
Yorker on off, squeezed off teh inner edge towards Gurbaz. Nigam wanted a run, expecting his partner to sprint through but had to scamper back
Spinning in from a length around off, he pats it to the on side with soft hands and retains strike. Narine's excellent spell is done
Length ball around off, punched through cover
Fuller on middle, almost chips it back to Narine
Almost through him! Identical ball to the one that got Stubbs, just that this one is outside off. Ashu comes forward to defend but is beaten on the inside

There's the big blow. Narine gets du Plessis, just why he perhaps chose to bowl off before the death overs. Narine floats the carrom ball outside leg, anticipating du Plessis to take on the midwicket boundary. Du Plessis clears his front leg to heave it over the on side but finds out Rinku at deep midwicket to perfection. DC have slipped from 136 for 3 to 146 for 6 now
Fuller on middle, spinning  in, hit back to the bowler
Reverses with some authority! Tossed up on off and middle, Nigam does not switch his grip but changes stance and hits it over short third
Outside off, slapped to deep cover
Fuller on middle, drilled back to Roy
Flatter and on a length outside off, he leaves it be
Very fuil on leg, squeezed back to Roy
Lands it on a length around middle, Nigam drives it back uppishly to long-off
Fuller outside off, drives it through extra cover

Through him! Narine's the boss and he shows why with a double-wicket over. Slips in another length ball on middle, Stubbs looks to push it straight back but is beaten on the inside. The ball deflects off his front pad onto the stumps. The trajectory drew Stubbs forward, but the dip did him in. KKR are back in this big time
Fuller on muddle, turned through midwicket
Fuller on off, driven to long-off
Fuller on off, he comes forward and pushes it to cover

And Narine has the last laugh to get Axar for the fourth time in T20 cricket. Narine comes around the wicket and digs it in the surface at a quicker pace. Almost like a fast bowler's offcutter. Axar looks to go back and loft it over extra cover but lobs it towards Rana, who takes a few steps to his right and takes that. The DC captain walks back with a grimace but he's played a gem
Greeted with a six! Tossed up length ball outside off, Axar gets down on a knee and slogs it high over wide long-on. Axar's best score this season
Slower and on a length down leg, looks to turn it across but gets it off the leading edge towards cover-point
My word! Axar's generated power with just his top hand. This is short and angling away from Axar, who is making room. He manages to reach out and takes his bottom hand off and gets it through cover
Loopy ball but down leg, he looks to steer it away fine but misses
Quicker one, looked like the carrom ball, he looks to whack it across the line but misses
Length again outside leg, Faf can only heave it towards wide long-on
Flatter on a length outside off, slapped through cover
Around the wicket, bowls it on a length outside leg, clipped through midwicket
Full toss again, outside off, drilled straight back down the ground. Powell runs around from long-off, dives but fails to save the boundary. Some return for the pain Axar is enduing
Low full toss outside off, 133.5kph, hit straight to cover
Full and wide outside off, left alone
Full and outside off, hit down to long-off
Yorker on off, 134.1kph, du Plessis is up to it and digs it out
Full and wide outside off, squeezed through cover
Smooooth, Axar bhai, smoooooth!. Full and angling away from him, he is deep in the crease and sweetly times the cover drive to beat sweeper comfortably
Full and outside off, drilled to cover, who half-stops it. And Dre Russ has overstepped
Full and tailing in on off, 139.2kph, driven back down the ground
Middled. Short and wide outside off, du Plessis covers his stumps and powers it through cover. Was the slower one, du Plessis picked it early
Angling in on a length, clipped through midwicket

Huuggeeee appeal! Gurbaz and Rana think Axar has feathered an edge. The umpire doesn't. And Rahane reviews. On first look it seemed ball brushed the back pad. It was an in-angler on a length froma round the stumps, Axar looked to tap it to third but the ball kept coming back in with the angle. He was cramped for room and it went through him to the wicketkeeper. The ball brushes the back leg and it would have hit Axar outside the line of the stumps
Thick outside edge, DC won't complain. Axar backs away to go big over cover but gets it off the outer edge well wide of short third. Axar, in pain, is inflicting some on KKR now
Full toss outside off, driven through cover for a 31-ball half-century that keeps DC afloat
Sits up and it's pulled flat over midwicket for six. Axar is grimacing though. Likely because of the left hand. Was a length ball on off that was forced with power
Length on fourth, driven off the back foot to cover's right. Rinku does well to rush and deny the single
Wide, slow length ball. Faf reaches out to cut it from outside the tramline, to deep point. 96ks, looked much slower
Shortish on off, 97ks, slow off the pitch and no turn, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Short fine leg's the only infielder on the leg side, so acres of space for the single there. Was a length ball on leg flicked to deep square leg
Length on off, clipped off the back foot through mmidwicket
Over long-on. Into the second tier. Dragged across from fifth stump after making room. Was a legbreak on a length that was flayed with a horizontal swing
Fullish on off, very fast looking legbreak, punched to cover without foot movement
Seam-up grip with a cross seam but it's too straight again. Faf glances this to the left of short fine leg
Catch it is the call but it beats Russell at deep midwicket to his right. That went flat and nearly half-volleyed the boundary cushion. Ball was a touch short, pacy and Faf read the length early
Fullish legbreak lands outside leg and goes to the outer-edge of the pad, flicked to backward square leg
Length on middle and leg, 94ks, looked to have spun in a touch. Faf backs away and works it off the back foot to long-on
Length on off, Faf slides his front foot towards midwicket and flicks through square leg
Makes room and gets followed. Length ball lands around leg and spins in sharply to beat the flick and hit the front pad
Length on the pads, tucked off the back foot through square leg
One-handed drive launched over long-on. Touch too full from Narine and Axar goes through with the drive
Length on leg, defended to the bowler's right
Punches the full ball down to long-off
Length on the pads, flicked to deep midwicket
Caressed off the back foot to sweeper cover
Full and flat on leg, looks to turn it leg side. Very gentle. So, the leading edge goes into ground, to cover

Direct hit from short fine, run-out referral sent upstairs. Narine not sue if it's out. Replay comes in.... and Rahul is short! Bat's just behind the crease as the bails light up. There was confusion in the running, Faf stopped halfway, Rahul committed but couldn't get over the line. Actually, replays show that he did stop for a step. Was a shortish ball following Faf as he made room and danced down, he looked to glance it fine. First time Rahul has been run out in the IPL since 2022
Good ball. Stock ball on a fullish length, angling in towards middle, Rahul backs away and drives off the back foot through cover
Wide on a length, cut to sweeper cover
Might've been seam up again. 116ks. But it's on the pads and Rahul glances it with ease
Drives the full ball to long-off

Inside edges a seam-up ball close to leg stump. Faf made room and was caught between the cut and the pull as the length ball came around knee-roll height. Varun did get Maxwell with that ball last game. Given byes, looked to me like it went off the edge though
Faf makes room but has to come back as Varun darts a full ball on fourth stump. Looks to scythe it square, toes it towards point
Rahul had cleared the stumps before the delivery. Got what looked like a googly. Into the pitch, spinning in towards the batter while following him; whipped off the back foot through mid-on
Length on leg, good bounce, flicked off the back foot to midwicket
Beaten on the pull, hits thigh. No, Faf actually inside edged it replay shows. Was a legcutter on a hard length that came straight on. At the stumps. Got decent bounce but didn't stick in the pitch

Similar to the ball that got Nair, but Faf stands his ground for the most part - beside the line. He then slides just a touch while drilling it hard and low. KL gets out the way as the ball shoots past his left hip
Length on fourth from wide of the crease, defended towards the off side

Big appeal from Vaibhav for lbw. There were two sounds. There's a longish chat about the edge between him and Rahane, they take the review. First replay and it looks a fantastic decision as the sound came off the bat hitting the ground, not ball. Nair's walking before ball tracking. His front foot had gotten to fourth stump to a full ball spearing in. The close-faced bat jammed the ground as Nair tried to flick it square, the ball pitched just in front of the crease and hit him on the left-half of the front boot. Hawk-Eye shows it'd go on to smash off stump. No heroics from Nair tonight
Low full toss is flicked along the ground through midwicket. Was an attempted seam-up yorker on leg, Nair made room and powered it through the bottom hand
Full-faced punch to mid-off. Fullish ball on fourth from wide of the crease. Pace looked good
Length on fourth, stands still and guides it to point
Pulls a length ball over midwicket. Counters Harshit's pace with power. Trusts the pitch too. Taken off the stumps
Overpitched, and that's whacked wide of mid-on. Faf was across to off, cleared his front leg to make room and hit it hard, across the line

Flat-batted high, not middled but it's too far for long-off. Powell ran to his right, was close to the boundary, could only get to it when the ball dribbled. Was a back-of-length ball on fifth, Faf didn't try to keep it down. Got it off the upper-half of the bat
At the stumps this time. Heaved to midwicket

Easy cut ball. Close to the off-side tramline, 142ks on a length, Faf has ample time to hit it through point. Past the diving Dre Russ. "What were you thinking," Rahane asks Harshit with clenched teeth
Full at the stumps, worked towards mid-on.

Even better from Anukul. Sees Faf make room again and goes towards the off-stump tramline at 85ks. Back of length. Faf has to run sideways and reach out to tap it towards cover. Lost his bottom hand along the way
Faf makes room, scuttles to the leg-stump tramline and Anukul darts a 95ks length ball at the pads. Beats the flick and ball dribbles forward
Swept off a length, taken from in front of the stumps to deep square leg
Similar stuff. Nair almost made too much room to the flat length ball on leg stump. He slapped it off the toe over cover
Nair makes room and slaps it over cover. Was a length ball following him and the shot was hit on the move
More inswing. Length ball curves in to top of off, Nair is behind the line and uses the movement by flicking off the back foot through backward square leg. Rinku speeds to the right to keep it to two
Looks to make room again but gets cramped by the fullish ball angling in. Faf pushes it against the angle, gets a single towards cover

Dances down and just chips it over the bowler. Turned a six-metre ball into a half-volley, made room too, so he could extend the arms and make a diagonal-bat drive look like it was off the straight bat
Full at the stumps, flicked through forward midwicket
Fullish inswinger. Comes in sharply towards fourth, driven nicely but finds cover
Fullish ball might've seamed in but landed down leg, went further. Beat the attempted whip from Nair
Straightens off the seam to beat the cover drive. Fuller side of length, lands around fourth and finishes on fifth, Nair tried to punch it firmly on top of the bounce
Fullish floaty stock ball stops in the pitch a bit. It's outside off and is spooned slightly uppishly. To long-off it goes
Length on middle and off, Faf goes back and flicks against the spin. Gets it to square leg
Length on fourth, punched to long-off
Length on middle, 95ks and spinning away a touch, defended to the bowler

The anti-match-up works for KKR. This was a case of the batter trying to cash in and miscuing. Porel danced down early to get the 90ks ball on a full length, he tried to slash it over extra cover. Bat turned in hand, Russell came in from cover take an easy catch.
Sits up and that's cut hard to point's left. Was a length ball on fourth that went straight on, Porel clearing the front leg made it look wide
